title: Recording with a disputed clock
brief: An 18-minute indoor phone video is offered as evidence of what happened in a room on Sunday 8 November 2026. Its on-screen time and file metadata say it started at 13:42:37 UTC. The other party says the device clock cannot be trusted. Establish independently when it was really recorded and whether the stated time holds.

claim.description: Device clock / metadata: recording started 2026-11-08 13:42:37 UTC (UK time = UTC in November).

evidence.label: Indoor video, 18 min (ceiling strip lights, people talking)
